examples.text: El banco tiene una hipoteca sobre su edificio.
examples.en: The bank holds a mortgage on his building.

examples.text: Cada vez más gente se está retrasando en el pago de la hipoteca.
examples.en: More and more people are falling behind in their mortgage payments.

examples.text: El peor escenario posible es que Tom pierda su trabajo y no sea capaz de seguir pagando su hipoteca.
examples.en: The worst-case scenario is that Tom will lose his job and won't be able to keep up his mortgage payments.
